description: What a look limited to the names the watcher gave makes of the verdict a whole walk would give a copy: a copy it no longer finds is gone only when an event said its name, or a folder above it, was deleted, or when its row already says it went; otherwise nothing is concluded of it, and the next pass walks the disk whole.

cases.note: deleted, as the event said: gone
no longer at its name, and no event said deleted: only moved-from explains it, and it may be anywhere the look did not go
its row says it went already, as a look found before: still gone
its row says it moved, and the look no longer finds it at its new name: the new name may be anywhere
its row says uncertain: nothing more is known than before
found at a name the look read, by its inode: moved, whatever an event said
found at its name as its row says
replaced by another file at its name
in Atoll's own trash or tmp: Atoll's own operation
two rows claim one name: uncertain, as a whole walk says
below a name the look could not reach: nothing is known
